articleTitle: IEE Colloquium on 'The RDS System - Its Implementation and Use' (Digest No.128)
publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on RDS System - Its Implementation and Use

articleTitle: The development of the RDS system from a European point of view and the possibilities for distributing traffic messages with RDS
publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on RDS System - Its Implementation and Use
abstract: The author considers the radio data system (RDS) as an international standard, and reviews the ways in which various countries are implementing it, including West Germany, France, and the United Kingdom. The problem of the restricted data transmission capacity is discussed, and the application of RDS to the distribution of traffic messages is explained.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>

articleTitle: Radio data system (RDS)-the planning and implementation of a new broadcast service (using high reliability systems)
publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on RDS System - Its Implementation and Use
abstract: The author explains the involvement of the BBC in the development of RDS, and discusses the initial planning. Equipment and system design is considered, and installation is described. Mid project problems and their solutions are overviewed, and the public launch is considered.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>

articleTitle: The radio data system from the receiver manufacturer's perspective
publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on RDS System - Its Implementation and Use
abstract: The author considers the provision of radio data systems (RDS) in Europe, and discusses the equipment needed for use with such systems. The conversion of a digitally tuned car radio into an RDS receiver is briefly overviewed, and the integration of the RDS demodulator is discussed. The author describes the working of the DC 682 RDS car radio, and data acquisition is considered.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>

publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on RDS System - Its Implementation and Use
abstract: The development of a conceptual model research receiver is described and gives insight into solutions for implementing RDS features in receivers. Changes made to the concept model between 1986 and 1988 are discussed, and further RDS features required for future receivers are considered.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>

articleTitle: The implementation of RDS in the United Kingdom's independent local radio network
publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on RDS System - Its Implementation and Use
abstract: The authors consider the role of the independent local radio network in the provision of a radio data system (RDS). They discuss radio teletext and other auxiliary transmissions, and consider the EBU RDS system. The encoder specification is outlined, and RDS installation at transmitter sights is described. Testing the installation and encoders is considered, and the RDS travel service is discussed.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>
